_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Specifications and Standards Usage Report
summary: The Specifications and Standards Usage Report provides information on the utilization of specifications and standards so appropriate interest in the documents can be included in coordination of proposals to revise or cancel the documents.
description_purpose: The Specifications and Standards Usage Report provides information on the utilization of specifications and standards so that appropriate interest in the documents can be included in coordination of all proposals to revise or cancel the documents.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-E-1106B.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Specifications and Standards Usage Report format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Specifications and Standards Usage Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Department of Defense specifications and standards.
children.content: Identification of all documents listed in the Department of Defense Index of Specifications and Standards (DODISS) selected for use on the contract.

children.title: Proposed specifications and standards.
children.content: Identification of all specifications and standards proposed for preparation under the contract.

children.title: Multiple-use program peculiar specifications.
children.content: Identification of all multiple-use program peculiar specifications as defined in MIL-STD-490 selected for use on the contract.

children.title: Exceptions to specifications and standards.
children.content: Identification of all drawings, Military Specification Exceptions as defined in DOD-STD-35, and program peculiar specifications which delineate exceptions, additions, or deletions to DODISS documents.

children.title: Standardization Agreements (STANAGS) and Quadripartite Standardization Agreements (QSTAGS).
children.content: Identification of all STANAGS and QSTAGS selected for use on the contract.
